install_tell: Hosted SaaS. Agent self-provisions an inbox; ships an INBOUND prompt-injection scanner (6 categories) + safeBodyForLLM() sanitizer. Team behind Palisade Research. No funding round disclosed.
misconfig_patterns: DIRECTION NOTE: LobsterMail guards the INBOUND path (untrusted mail -> agent context). It is the inverse of the Cat-33 thesis (outbound LLM draft -> recipient). Cataloged as the documented mirror, NOT an in-category outbound platform.

active_probe.false_positive_check: Brand anchor on lobstermail.ai apex + 'prompt injection'/'inbox'.

deployment_tells: Hosted; self-provisioning agent inbox; safeBodyForLLM() is the named sanitizer primitive.
pivot_paths: Inbound-mirror structural finding: inbound agent-mail safety EXISTS at the substrate (LobsterMail, MailGuard MCP), outbound content safety does NOT — the asymmetry is the Cat-33 category finding.

competitive_lane.lane: C (inbox agent) INBOUND — mirror of Cat-33, not in-category
competitive_lane.differentiator: Defends the inbound context-poisoning boundary (the mirror image of outbound LLM-draft guarding).
